# RepoNPC P2 fixture repository

This local-only repository is original, non-secret test material. It models a
hybrid retrieval service with exact symbols and paths for deterministic tests.

The `rank_evidence` function combines lexical and vector candidates. The
`compileSearchRequest` TypeScript helper keeps user text as a value before a
database adapter executes it. These claims describe fixture code, not a real
person's work history.

繁體中文：此專案是人工撰寫的測試語料。它以 FTS 與向量排名建立混合檢索，並
保留可驗證的來源識別碼。`rank_evidence` 與 `compileSearchRequest` 是供測試查詢的
精確符號名稱。
